description: List the on-chain memory objects owned by an entity. Each object has an object id, a numeric object type, owner, creation and update heights, and hex encoded data. Object type codes: 0 ChainSummary, 1 LabelIndex, 2 EmbeddingCommitment, 3 AnomalyLog, 4 StatisticsSnapshot, 5 ReputationEvent, 6 Rating, 7 SignalCatalog, 8 CompositionGraph, 9 VerificationRecord, 10 DelegationGrant, 11 Subscription, 12 ServiceDescriptor, 13 VkRegistration, 14 SlaAgreement, 15 PaymentChannel.
name: novai_get_memory_objects
title: NOVAI memory objects by entity
